name: Grol'dom Farm
summary: Along the road from Durotar to the Crossroads, Grol'dom Farm raises swine in the northern Barrens. Kranal Fiss and his family work the homestead, despite constant harassment from aggressive local quilboars.

sections.title: A Swine Farm in the Savannah
sections.body: Established after Durotar was settled, Grol'dom Farm is an early Horde effort to farm the dry Barrens. Kranal Fiss and his children tend the homestead and raise pigs, while Razormane quilboar raiders prowl the nearby ridges. The farm supplies sustenance to the emerging orcish nation, though life here remains lonely and rugged.

sections.title: A Beacon for Young Shaman
sections.body: Grol'dom Farm is a pig farm, but its purpose reaches beyond that daily work. Kranal Fiss knows the elemental rites and plays a key part in guiding young shaman through their trials. Horde initiates on the spiritual path hold the farm in quiet regard, and seekers traveling west from Orgrimmar are regularly directed here to learn how to commune with the primal spirits of fire.

faq.answer: Grol'dom Farm is an orcish swine farm in the northern Barrens, along the road between Durotar and the Crossroads. Established after Orgrimmar was founded, it is a remote homestead worked by Kranal Fiss and his children.
Kranal Fiss and his children live at the farm. They tend the pens, herd the pigs, and defend their meager livelihood against roving beasts and quilboar raiders.

faq.q: Why do shamans come to Grol'dom Farm?
faq.answer: Kranal Fiss knows the elemental rites, and orc and tauren shaman are routinely sent to speak with him during their early training. He guides them through trials needed to earn their Call of Fire and manifest the Fire Totem.
Razormane quilboars from the surrounding savannah constantly harass the farm. Their raids threaten the livestock and endanger Kranal's family.

angles.text: As a shaman initiate walking the elemental path, you come to Grol'dom Farm to face the dangerous rites Kranal Fiss guides you through, rites needed to commune with the spirits of fire.
As a member of the Horde, you can see in Grol'dom Farm the grit early settlers need to make a sustainable life in the harsh, untamed Barrens.
